description: Pinterest conversion tag requests to ct.pinterest.com, including the noscript image fallback.

params.name: tid
params.description: It is the Pinterest conversion tag ID.
params.fix_hint: Copy the tag ID from Ads Manager into `tid`.

params.name: event
params.description: The base code omits it; event code sends one. Custom event names are allowed, so check that an unrecognized value is deliberate and not a misspelled standard event.

params.name: noscript
params.description: The image fallback in the base code sends `noscript=1`.

params.name: ed[value]
params.description: It is the purchase value on the noscript image. Pinterest documents `ed[value]` on checkout and add to cart tags.
params.fix_hint: Send a number in `ed[value]`, without a currency symbol.

params.name: ed[currency]
params.description: It is the ISO 4217 currency of `ed[value]`. Pinterest documents `ed[currency]` on the image tag.
params.fix_hint: Send a three-letter currency code in `ed[currency]`, such as `USD`.

params.name: ed[order_quantity]
params.description: It is the order quantity on the noscript image. Pinterest documents `ed[order_quantity]` next to `ed[value]`.
params.fix_hint: Send an integer item count in `ed[order_quantity]`.

rules.message: A checkout or add-to-cart tag is missing `ed[value]` or `ed[currency]`. Pinterest documents those keys on the image tag for conversion reporting.
rules.fix_hint: Add `ed[value]` and `ed[currency]` to the noscript image, or fire the event from JavaScript.
